newsitem.title: FINLAND: ANALYSTS SEE STOCKMANN H1 PRETAX HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSTS SEE STOCKMANN H1 PRETAX HIGHER.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 103 million markka median forecast for Finnish retail group Oy Stockmann Ab's first half profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by nine analysts, EPS by five analysts)
Stockmann's results are due on August 19 around 1200/0900 GMT.
In January-June last year, Stockmann had a 95.6 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
In March, Stockmann said it expected its 1997 earnings to match the 1996 level when it posted a 315 million markka profit.

For the full-year 1997, five of the nine analysts polled gave a median forecast of 339 million markka (mean 339.3 million) in a 330-357 million markka range. The median EPS forecast was 16.7 markka and the range was 16.40-17.80 markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, AG Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Merita Securities and Opstock.
